title: Ops Control Plane Contract
summary: Project SRE hosting, deployment and observability controls with locked dangerous actions; tenant data administration is excluded.

criteria: The audience of the ops control plane is fixed as the operator/SRE, and its subject is infrastructure state rather than tenant business records.
The projected control set is limited to hosting, deployment control and observability views, and the plane stays read-mostly by default.
Every mutating control is classified: a dangerous action lock requires a second approval inside a declared approval window, with step-up MFA and JIT time-bounded privilege.
The plane is a projection and not a security boundary: authority is decided by PDP, and the projection never becomes the enforcement point.

The exclusion set is explicit: tenant data administration excluded, no deployment authority is claimed here, panel implementation, surface schema, identity/authentication lifecycle and ECA/ruleset automation all stay outside.

Planning-only projection scope: hosting, deployment control and observability views, kept read-mostly so that inspection is the default and mutation is the exception.

Planning-only dangerous-action contract: a dangerous action lock released only by a second approval inside a declared approval window, with every attempt written to an immutable audit.

Explicit human approval gate with fixed exclusions: tenant data administration excluded, no deployment authority claimed, and panel implementation, surface schema, identity/authentication lifecycle and ECA/ruleset automation all left to their own contracts.

risks.desc: Treating the highest-privilege plane as a permanently granted role would leave standing operator access that survives the incident it was granted for.
risks.mitigation: Require step-up MFA plus JIT time-bounded privilege on a narrow role, and prove expiry with negatives before human-approved implementation.

risks.desc: A destructive control such as delete or scale-to-zero executed by one operator without review would be unrecoverable and untraceable.
risks.mitigation: Require a dangerous action lock released only by a second approval inside a declared approval window, with every attempt in an immutable audit.

risks.desc: Treating the ops projection as an enforcement point would let a projection bug become an authorization bypass across planes.
risks.mitigation: State that the plane is not a security boundary, delegate every decision to PDP and prove cross-plane isolation with negatives.

risks.desc: An ops plane contract could be misread as authority to administer tenant data, execute deployments or define panel implementation and surface schema.
risks.mitigation: Keep the tenant data administration excluded, no deployment authority, panel implementation, surface schema, identity/authentication lifecycle and ECA/ruleset automation exclusions explicit, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: The ops control plane is the operator/SRE view of infrastructure state; its subject is the platform itself rather than any tenant business record.
Girdi is hosting, deployment control and observability signals; çıktı is a read-mostly projection plus a small classified set of mutating controls.
Every mutating control carries a dangerous action lock, so the durum path is inspect, propose, second approval inside an approval window, then act.
Access is a narrow role behind step-up MFA with JIT time-bounded privilege, and every action and refusal lands in an immutable audit.
Kapsam sınırı gereği bu plane not a security boundary and delegates to PDP; tenant data administration excluded and no deployment authority is claimed.

Kapsa: operator/SRE audience over infrastructure state, hosting/deployment control/observability projection, read-mostly default, dangerous action lock with second approval, JIT privilege and immutable audit. Exclude tenant data administration, deployment execution, panel implementation and surface schema. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: This is the highest-privilege plane, so erişim needs a narrow rol behind step-up MFA and is issued as JIT time-bounded privilege rather than standing authority.
The plane is not a security boundary: every request is decided by PDP, and a deny is terminal, so a projection defect cannot become an authorization bypass.
cross-plane isolation and least privilege keep the ops session inside infrastructure state; tenant data administration excluded means a tenant record is unreachable, not merely hidden.
A dangerous action lock plus a second approval inside an approval window guards destructive controls, and every attempt is written to an immutable audit with denetim value.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one typed projection model per control-plane katman rather than a bespoke ops client, so the four planes share a validated shape.
Dangerous-action classification and approval-window evaluation stay pure functions with low cyclomatic complexity, testable without any hosting backend.
Projection and enforcement stay separated; ölü kod and speculative operator abstractions are refused, and engineering rules are reached through standardRefs rather than restated here.
codeOptimization.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/codeOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
codeOptimization.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract codeOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: shared typed projection model, pure classification and approval logic, projection/enforcement separation, referenced standards. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: The mutating control set is an explicit allowlist; anything outside it is unavailable in the plane rather than merely hidden from the projection.
Least ayrıcalık is time-shaped: an operator grant expires with its window, and secret material for hosting access is never surfaced through the plane.
Approval records and audit entries are integrity-protected with an imza so a second approval cannot be forged after the fact, and rate limits bound repeated dangerous-action attempts.
securityOptimization.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: allowlisted mutating controls, expiring least-privilege grants without secret exposure, signed approval and audit records with rate limits. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: A p95 budget is declared for rendering the read-mostly hosting and observability projection over a realistic fleet size; no measurement is claimed here.
Projection reads use a bounded cache with an explicit staleness label, because an operator must never mistake a cached infrastructure view for live state.
Fleet listings page through a cursor and must avoid N+1 lookups against per-instance metric sources when the projection is expanded.
performance.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: p95 budget for the ops projection, bounded cache with explicit staleness, cursor paging and N+1-free metric expansion. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: A mobil operator session sees the same projection and the same locks as a desktop one; a cihaz may not carry a widened control set.
Offline use is read-only: a cached infrastructure view is labelled stale, and no dangerous action may be queued for later replay from a disconnected client.
No operator panel implementation is introduced here; rendering the plane and its approval prompts stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: identical projection and locks across devices, read-only offline with stale labelling, no panel implementation here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future operator surface must expose lock state and remaining privilege time as accessible text, keyboard reachable with a visible odak ring at the AAA kontrast threshold.
A dangerous-action confirmation must be announced through an aria live region and must not rely on colour alone to signal that a second approval is still missing.
This contract defines projection semantics only, so no accessibility conformance may be recorded here and every such result stays planned.
wcag.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: accessible lock and privilege-time state, announced dangerous-action confirmations without colour-only signalling, semantics-only scope. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; describing which Kubernetes or container control a plane may project is not the same as executing one, and no deployment authority is claimed.
Health and readiness signals are projected as observability inputs; acting on them stays behind the dangerous action lock and its approval window.
Withdrawing this shard affects only the planning contract and its deterministic projections, so rollback is bounded, runtimeDataImpact remains none and NO-GO stands.
deployment.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: projection without deployment execution, health and readiness as observability inputs, bounded withdrawal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: An infrastructure olay may open a proposal in the plane, but ECA/ruleset automation is owned elsewhere and no rule may release a dangerous action lock by itself.
An automated proposal still needs a human second approval inside the approval window, and a triggered chain stops at maxChainDepth 6.
Re-emitting the same event must be idempotent so a retry does not create a duplicate operator proposal or a duplicate audit claim.
eca.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: events open proposals only, human approval retained, depth-bounded chains and idempotent replay. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: AI may read this contract and suggest a changeset, but generating or updating an app or module, overriding a ruleset and writing directly to production are forbidden actions ve yasak kalır.
AI can never supply the second approval for a dangerous action, cannot hold operator privilege and cannot shorten or reopen an approval window; every apply step needs insan onayı.
sub_prompt is treated as untrusted input, the kill switch stays available, and no prompt or repository text may widen this shard's fixed D01 scope or fabricate executed-test evidence.
aiAgents.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and suggest-changeset only, AI barred from approvals and operator privilege, untrusted sub_prompt and kill switch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases cover an operator/SRE reading hosting and observability projections under a narrow role, as unit and integration matrices.
Planned negatives prove a dangerous action lock cannot be released without a second approval, an open approval window and step-up MFA.
Planned negatives prove cross-plane isolation and that a tenant record is unreachable from an ops session, since tenant data administration excluded is enforced.
Planned negatives prove a PDP deny is terminal and that expired JIT time-bounded privilege revokes access mid-session rather than at next login.
Planned audit cases prove every action and refusal produces an immutable audit entry; no result may be recorded before a real human-approved run exists.
testing.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: operator read positives, lock and approval negatives, cross-plane isolation, terminal PDP deny, privilege expiry and immutable audit evidence. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A01 broken access control is modeled by delegating every decision to PDP and proving cross-plane isolation, since the projection is explicitly not a security boundary.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled by making the plane read-mostly and gating each destructive control behind a dangerous action lock with a second approval.
OWASP A09 logging and monitoring failures are modeled by an immutable audit for every action and refusal, with structured loglama that supports incident reconstruction.
owasp.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A01 via PDP delegation and plane isolation, A04 via read-mostly design and dual approval, A09 via immutable audit and structured logging. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-control-planes with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-control-planes] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
All three publicBoundary flags stay false, so the ops plane touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; signals arrive as olay input instead.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor control-plane-taxonomy-contract ends 2028-06-09, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.
dependsOn stays exactly control-plane-taxonomy-contract, and the parent-only k-tenancy, be-deploy-profilleri and adr-0015 bağımlılık edges are not inherited.

Scope stays inside the projection layer: tenant data administration excluded, no deployment authority, and panel implementation, surface schema, identity/authentication lifecycle and ECA/ruleset automation stay outside.
integration.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing under areaId k-control-planes, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: An operator tooling module tüketir this projection through its declared contract rather than issuing a doğrudan veritabanı read against infrastructure records.
A consumer must preserve the plane's audience and lock semantics; it cannot re-expose an ops control inside a tenant-facing product surface.
Deciding access belongs to PDP and rendering belongs to panel implementation; this contract projects, it neither decides nor renders.
moduleUsage.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: contract-mediated consumption without direct database reads, preserved audience and lock semantics, excluded decision and rendering authority. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: Operator identity, session and approval records are kişisel veri, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
The immutable audit is retained on its own saklama takvimi and is never deleted to satisfy an erasure request; erasure is expressed as operator-identifier anonymisation instead.
Infrastructure telemetry projected by the plane must not carry tenant business payloads, and any change to the retained record shape follows an expand-contract migration.
dataLifecycle.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: operator personal-data classification, audit retention with anonymisation instead of deletion, payload-free telemetry and expand-contract evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrics include projection freshness, dangerous-action attempt and approval rates, privilege-grant duration distribution and PDP deny counts on operator-safe labels.
Structured log and trace records carry the operator identity, the grant window and the control name; infrastructure secrets and tenant payloads are redacted and never become metric labels.
Alerts cover a dangerous action attempted outside an approval window, an unusually long privilege grant and a projection staleness breach; thresholds and the runbook require human approval.
observability.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: projection freshness and privilege SLIs, redacted operator-scoped traces, out-of-window and stale-projection alerts with a human-approved runbook. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is an unavailable PDP or a stale infrastructure feed; the plane degrades to a read-only, explicitly stale view rather than to a permissive fallback.
Control invocation is idempotent by construction: repeating an approved action within its window must not multiply the effect, and retries use bounded backoff.
Losing the audit path is treated as a fail-closed condition: if an action cannot be recorded immutably, it is refused rather than executed unlogged.
reliability.notes: ops-control-plane-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: Ops Control Plane Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: read-only stale degradation, idempotent control invocation with bounded retry, fail-closed behaviour when the audit path is unavailable. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
